name: qsv
description: Ultra-fast CSV data processing toolkit with 50+ commands and Python integration

qsv.description: Ultra-fast CSV toolkit with 50+ commands for data processing
qsv.usage:
qsv stats data.csv
qsv select 1,3,5 data.csv
qsv filter 'age > 30' data.csv
qsv join id file1.csv file2.csv
qsv frequency column data.csv

qsvdp.description: QSV DataPusher version with enhanced data uploading and API integration capabilities
qsvdp.usage: qsvdp upload data.csv --api-endpoint https://api.example.com\nqsvdp validate schema.json data.csv\nqsvdp transform rules.json data.csv

qsvlite.description: Lightweight version of QSV with core functionality for basic CSV operations
qsvlite.usage:
qsvlite stats data.csv
qsvlite select 1,3 data.csv
qsvlite headers data.csv
qsvlite count data.csv

qsvlite-nightly.description: Nightly development build of QSV Lite with latest experimental features

qsvp.description: QSV Pro version with advanced analytics and enterprise features
qsvp.usage: qsvp analyze --advanced data.csv\nqsvp ml-predict model.json data.csv\nqsvp enterprise-export data.csv

qsvpdp.description: QSV Pro DataPusher combining enterprise features with API integration
qsvpdp.usage: qsvpdp enterprise-upload data.csv --secure-api https://enterprise.api.com\nqsvpdp audit-trail data.csv\nqsvpdp compliance-check data.csv

qsvplite.description: QSV Pro Lite version with balanced features and performance
qsvplite.usage: qsvplite pro-stats data.csv\nqsvplite advanced-join file1.csv file2.csv\nqsvplite optimize data.csv

qsvpy310.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.10 for advanced data processing and scripting
qsvpy310.usage: qsvpy310 py 'df.describe()' data.csv\nqsvpy310 script analysis.py data.csv\nqsvpy310 py 'import numpy; df.mean()' data.csv

qsvpy311.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.11 offering improved performance for data science workflows
qsvpy311.usage: qsvpy311 py 'df.groupby("category").sum()' data.csv\nqsvpy311 ml-train model.py data.csv\nqsvpy311 py 'df.plot()' data.csv

qsvpy312.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.12 featuring latest Python optimizations and syntax
qsvpy312.usage: qsvpy312 py 'match df.shape[0]: case n if n > 1000: print("Large dataset")' data.csv\nqsvpy312 py 'df.query("age > @threshold")' data.csv\nqsvpy312 async-process data.csv

qsvpy313.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.13 beta featuring cutting-edge Python developments
qsvpy313.usage: qsvpy313 py --experimental 'df.new_feature()' data.csv\nqsvpy313 py 'df.enhanced_typing()' data.csv\nqsvpy313 beta-analysis data.csv

qsv-nightly.description: Nightly development build of QSV with latest features and experimental commands
qsv-nightly.usage:
qsv_nightly experimental-command data.csv
qsv_nightly beta-stats data.csv
qsv_nightly --nightly-info
qsv_nightly bleeding-edge data.csv
